description: Representative idle Android Settings root as the FULL nested tree the open-device-server emits over `getState({nested:true})` (phase 3i host micro-bench). Synthetic but realistically shaped: a status-bar system window (dropped by the v2 trim), a toolbar with a search field, and a scrollable RecyclerView of settings rows (each a clickable LinearLayout > icon + title/summary), with off-screen rows the host scroll-clip prunes. Renders to ~667 o200k tokens (device idle Settings is 657). NOT a device capture; the CI bench provides the authoritative device numbers.
